entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I'm calling about my new VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. I'd like to start a return for it.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and the order number, please?
Sure, the name is Sam Jones, and the order number is VF-8675309.
Thank you, Sam. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered on December 15th. That was about 17 days ago. What seems to be the issue with the device?
Honestly, it's just not what I was hoping for. The interface is quite confusing and I've found it really hard to use for tracking my workouts. I expected more, to be honest.
I see. I'm sorry to hear it's not meeting your expectations.

Yeah, I even read the user manual cover to cover, but it didn't help. Look, I know I'm a little past the two-week mark. Since it's opened, would you consider a partial credit or maybe a discount code for a future purchase instead of a full return? I'm willing to be flexible.

I appreciate the offer, Sam, but let me just check our official policy. One moment... Okay, I'm looking at our knowledge base here. It says all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Oh, 90 days? I had no idea. I thought it would be much shorter.
Yes, so you are well within the window. There's no need for partial credit. I can approve a full refund for you right now.
Wow, that's fantastic! I was prepared for a negotiation. In that case, yes, let's please proceed with the full return.

Excellent. I've just processed the return authorization. I'm sending you an email right now with the pre-paid shipping label and instructions. Just pack it back in its original box and drop it off. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed.
That was much easier than I expected. Thank you for your help, Alex.
You're very welcome, Sam. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
